description: A C_PDU larger than dts.max_segment_size goes out as three type 7 D_PDUs with one C_PDU ID, offsets 0, 8 and 16, in one transmission.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ. The U_PDU "segment-me-now" (14 bytes, priority 0, TTL 0 so TTD = 1296000000 ms, A-0089, A-0091) makes a 20-byte DATA C_PDU (B-0297). The DTS queues it and starts dts.ttd at its TTD (C-0857, C-0864, C-1050); the MAC starts csma.lbt_wait 30000 (K-0070). dts.max_segment_size is 8, so the C_PDU is cut, when the transmission first places it, into segments of 8, 8 and 4 bytes (C-0523, C-0525, C-0529, C-0549), every one with C_PDU ID 0 (C-0326, C-0527, C-1040), C_PDU size 20 (C-0343) and offsets 0, 8 and 16 (C-0346, C-0347, C-0528, C-0529). Seed 0 draws slot 15, cont wait 45000 (K-0080). Fixture: 64-byte blocks of 4800 ms, preamble 600, flush 150. The D_PDUs are 33, 33 and 29 bytes, so the third starts in block 1; the burst is 95 bytes, two blocks, 10350 ms. EOT = ceil((duration - block start) / 500): 20, 20, 10 (C-0104, C-1043); every copy is in this transmission, so each reception window equals its EOT (C-0350, C-0352). Placing the last of the C_PDU empties the queue, so dts.ttd is cancelled before the transmit output (C-1050).
